# Wikipedia excerpts

The HTML files here are excerpts from English Wikipedia articles, kept as test
inputs for the parsers in `src/monitor/ref/`. Wikipedia's contributors wrote
them, and they are available under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
This project's MIT license does not cover them. The files are cut down to the
tables the parsers read, and are otherwise unchanged.

| File | Article |
|---|---|
| `senate.html` | [2026 United States Senate elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections) |
| `house.html` | [2026 United States House of Representatives elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections) |
| `house_ratings.html` | [2026 United States House of Representatives election ratings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_election_ratings) |
| `governor.html` | [2026 United States gubernatorial elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_gubernatorial_elections) |
| `attorney_general.html` | [2026 United States attorney general elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_attorney_general_elections) |
| `measures.html` | [2026 United States ballot measures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_ballot_measures) |
